title: 01 Northstar Employee Handbook
content:
Northstar Field Services Pvt. Ltd. — Employee
Handbook
Document ID: HR-POL-001 | Version 3.1 | Effective: 01 April 2026
Office: 14 Meridian Park, Sector 18, Bellmere 402118
Working hours: 09:30–18:00 Monday–Friday. Field technicians follow assigned rosters.
Leave policy
Employees receive 18 annual paid leave days, 8 casual/sick days, and 10 public holidays. Leave of
more than 3 consecutive working days requires manager approval.
Travel reimbursement
Local travel is reimbursed up to I1,200 per day with receipts. Inter-city rail travel is reimbursed at
AC Chair Car or equivalent. Hotel reimbursement is capped at I4,500 per night unless Finance
pre-approves an exception.
Remote work
Up to 8 remote-work days per month may be requested by eligible office staff. Customer-site staff
are excluded unless their supervisor records an exception.

title: Customer Support FAQ
content:
Customer Support FAQ

How quickly are emergency calls handled?

Gold and Platinum customers receive an initial response within 2 business hours. Silver customers receive an initial response within 4 business hours.

Can a technician arrive outside normal hours?

Yes, if the contract includes after-hours coverage. Check the account record before confirming.

Who can approve a contract exception?

Regional Operations Managers may approve operational exceptions up to 25,000 INR. Finance approval is required for reimbursement exceptions.

Is the FAQ always current?

This page is maintained by Customer Operations. Contract-specific terms override general FAQ guidance.
